Grid Functions

NGSolve grid function documentation portal

class ngsolve.GridFunction
a field approximated in some finite element space

Keyword arguments can be:

multidim:

Multidimensional GridFunction

nested: bool = False

Generates prolongation matrices for each mesh level and prolongates the solution onto the finer grid after a refinement.

autoupdate:

Automatically update on FE space update
